parameters.content:
## Manual paid API pilot
Review inputs and current credit rules before one request. Select your own Header Auth credential; no key belongs in this JSON. Leave Sheets disabled while checking the returned supplier object and mapped rows. Configure a scratch destination using the CSV headings before enabling writes. No automatic retry, schedule or pagination. In-run deduplication is not persistent delivery state. This starter does not publish, send messages or call an LLM.
